description: This bar chart illustrates the average entropy across sycophancy reduction methods on static experiments for different AI models. The horizontal axis represents the different AI models, labeled “GPT-4”, “Claude”, and “T5”, in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Entropy Average Values”, displays a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Three sets of bars are presented for each AI model, representing the “Baseline” method (light red), the “Source Info” method (light yellow), and the “Direct Command” method (light blue). For GPT-4, the “Baseline” bar extends to approximately 5.2, the “Source Info” bar to approximately 4.8, and the “Direct Command” bar to approximately 5.1. For Claude, the “Baseline” bar extends to approximately 4.7, the “Source Info” bar to approximately 4.4, and the “Direct Command” bar to approximately 4.8. For T5, the “Baseline” bar extends to approximately 4.6, the “Source Info” bar to approximately 4.2, and the “Direct Command” bar to approximately 4.7. The bars are grouped by AI model, with each method represented by a distinct color within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
